why:
The briefs avoid both must_not items.

Item 1: the verifier's Check 6 bases PASS or FAIL on `npm test; echo "exit=$?"` and the grep of test/. `npm run test:cli` shows up only under "Advisory (does not change any PASS or FAIL above)", which also says "Its absence is not a failure." So no check depends on it.

Item 2: the builder brief brings up a general option only to rule it out: "Do not add quoting rules, separator auto-detection, a general --sep/--delimiter option, --help..." It asks only for a `--tsv` check that calls `parse(text, '\t')`.

The verifier's optional probes (flag position, CRLF input) are marked outside the acceptance lines and don't ask for any option the issue's non-goals rule out.
